description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component 'RepoPreviewHeader' for displaying repository preview information in the FDroid app, including repository details, status warnings, and action buttons. It also contains several preview composable functions for different repository states.

methods.name: RepoPreviewHeader
methods.description: Composable function that displays repository information, status warnings, and action buttons based on the fetch state.

methods.name: RepoPreviewScreenNewMirrorPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for a new mirror repository state.

methods.name: RepoPreviewScreenNewRepoAndNewMirrorPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for a new repository and mirror state.

methods.name: RepoPreviewScreenExistingRepoPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for an existing repository state.

methods.name: RepoPreviewScreenExistingMirrorPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for an existing mirror repository state.
